text: {"score":4,"justification":"The summary is accurate and well grounded. Every number matches the card: 20.7% vs 3.7% expected, risk-adjusted score 6.63, z of 3.06, 3 of 7 documented 99215 claims (43%) below the billed level, and 5 of 21 with no lab line. Language is cautious ('consistent with', 'not a finding'). The next steps are concrete, and the cited claims mostly fit their sentences. Weaknesses are small. One cited example is contradictory or non-supporting, the comparison is partly vague, and some limits are not flagged.","problems":["C0081673 is cited as an example but is a documented 99215 that supports the billed level (high MDM). It is not clearly labeled as a counter-example, so it muddies the below-billed point.","C0081694 has no documentation record, so it only illustrates low complexity; it sits among documentation examples without that being explained.","The '39% of 99215 claims on patients with 0 or 1 conditions' figure is not tied to any cited claim in the sentence; the card gives 0.388, so it is fine, but the summary does not say it applies to all 49 claims.","The comparison '0% for comparison providers' comes from a small sample (7 documented 99215 claims) and the small-sample limitation is not flagged.","The summary does not note that only 12.7% of claims have records, so documentation findings may not be representative.","The 5 of 21 'no lab line' finding is not tied to any cited claim, and the caveat that this may be weak evidence is missing.","C0081822 lacks patient details (age, conditions) in the example, so an investigator cannot see its complexity from the summary."]}
